description: Store up to 100 memory entries in ONE call. REQUIRES A KEY (or a sandbox_key from start_sandbox). Counts as one call against the rate limit and one packet per entry against the monthly quota, so prefer it over many remember calls. All or nothing: duplicate ids or a blocked entry reject the whole batch before anything is stored. Does not call any language model.

item_id.description: Optional. a-z, 0-9, - and _, at most 64 characters. Same id overwrites. Omit for a generated one.

sandbox_key.description: Optional. A temporary key from start_sandbox, for trying without an account.

name: remember_batch
title: Store many memory entries
